payload.rationale: Deployment reports-worker pods are stuck in Pending state with FailedScheduling due to an unmatched nodeSelector constraint (requiring 'disk=nvme' while node1 has label 'storage=nvme') and missing the required 'dedicated=reports:NoSchedule' toleration for node1. Applying a targeted strategic merge patch to the deployment pod template resolves both constraints without altering cluster node taints or scheduling onto unowned nodes.
payload.rollback_trigger: Rollback if reports-worker pods remain Unschedulable, fail readiness probes, or violate SLO error rate (> 0.001) / latency (> 200ms) thresholds over consecutive evaluation windows.

success_criteria.description: Deployment reports-worker reaches 1/1 Ready replicas scheduled on node1, and the reports-worker endpoints become active with HTTP 5xx error rate < 0.001 and p95 latency < 200ms.
